headline: Coca Cola (KO) Appoints Luca Santandrea To Lead Poland And The Baltics
summary: Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) has appointed Luca Santandrea as General Director for Poland and the Baltics. Santandrea brings experience in marketing, sales, and business management across multiple international markets. The appointment covers Coca-Cola operations across Poland and the Baltic states, including work with local bottling partners.
